verdict: Meta delivered 124 leads at a $11.84 CPL over the last 28 days, with the top campaign "BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness" driving $777.65 of the $1,467.77 in spend. performance.verdict: CPL is fine; pipeline conversion and 3 overdue deliverables threaten August scoreboard.

findings.text: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both overdue — without these, the lead-to-patient scoreboard cannot be read.
Renewal closed 2026-07-23 (due milestone) — August prove-it clock is running; <20 attributable new patients over prior 7 months is the bar to beat.
CPL held at ~$11.84 over 28 days and dipped only -4.44% this week — efficiency is stable, but spend pulled back -22.36% week-over-week, compressing lead volume to the recent low.
3-day signal (Aug 14–16): spend averaged $26.91/day vs $65.85/day the prior 3 days — a sharp spend step-down, not creative fatigue, is driving the 3-day lead collapse to 5 leads vs 16.
GHL shows 80 opportunities created vs 0 won and 0 appointments in the 28-day window against 124 Meta leads — 262 contacts but no booked chair time visible; intake leak likely, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Complete phone-match attribution and sync/contact cleanup immediately — both overdue milestones block August scoreboard readability.
suggestions.monday_update: Both the phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) are overdue and must be resolved this week. Without these, the lead-to-patient pipeline cannot be tracked, and the August renewal decision will be made blind. Success is confirmed when attribution is live and the GHL contact list reflects clean, deduplicated records — target completion by 2026-08-20.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 124 leads vs 0 appointments in 28 days signals a front-desk or pipeline-stage leak, not an ads problem.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL recorded 80 opportunities created and 0 appointments against 124 Meta leads in the 28-day window — the gap between lead arrival and booked appointments must be diagnosed with Lily and the new intake hire. Check pipeline stage movement, GHL-to-Flex Dental handoff, and whether leads are being contacted within SLA. Success is at least 10 documented appointments visible in GHL within 7 days of this fix; re-check 2026-08-24.

suggestions.text: Watch spend recovery: daily spend dropped to $18.51–$41.10 over last 3 days vs $64.90 prior — confirm cause before adjusting budget.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend fell sharply over Aug 14–16, averaging $26.91/day vs $65.85/day the prior 3-day window; CPL remains healthy at $11.84 so efficiency is not the issue. Confirm whether this is a deliberate budget pull, a billing/payment event, or a campaign-level cap being hit. If spend normalises above $50/day with CPL holding below $15, no further action needed — re-check 2026-08-20.
